thesis: Pre-open news pack for 2026-09-03 contains mostly diffuse macroeconomic color (labor market stability notes, pre-Labor Day commentary), personal-finance filler, routine politician transaction filings, and speculative or single-name promotional commentary (e.g. Dividend King listicle, boutique robotics/EV profiles, crypto pricing updates, Medtronic earnings summary). While there are generic bullish data-center/AI headlines (an $89B Nvidia commentary piece, Cerebras AI data center in Finland), our balanced portfolio is already properly exposed to semiconductor and tech leadership via existing NVDA and XLK positions. With 4 positions (cap 6), all single names well under the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and $35.00 cash (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor), holding all positions maintains discipline and avoids unnecessary turnover.
